sentences.text: This is a city.
A city has many buildings.
The buildings are big and small.
Some buildings are new.
Some buildings are old.
This is a story about old buildings.
The old buildings are empty.
No people are in the old buildings.
They are very quiet places.
The walls are grey and brown.
The windows are dark.
Some windows are broken.
The doors are closed.
It is an old place.
It is not a home for people now.
It is a place for memories.
But look.
It is a home for plants.
Nature is here.
A plant is on the wall.
It is a small green plant.
The leaves are very green.
Here is a flower.
The flower is yellow.
It is in a small crack in the wall.
The plant and the flower are a surprise.
More plants are here.
Plants are on the floor.
They are big plants with big leaves.
A small tree is on the roof.
The tree is green and strong.
It is very beautiful.
Many small flowers are on the floor.
The flowers are red, yellow, and white.
They are like a small, wild garden.
The grey walls are a background.
The green plants are the picture.
The red and yellow flowers are the bright colors.
Nature is very strong.
Nature is beautiful in strange places.
New life is in old places.

questions.text: Are the buildings big or small?
Is the plant big or small?
